title: 7 cyclic cube fields with weight-conditioned admission

claims.statement: The explicit 7-field degree-143 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-31 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 59067540857677449/1000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=9696361624460279422243547028650437618068727928854685112391908 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(101297/500).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles (0), field, orbit count and primitive bound (1), exact weight-indexed child admission (2), and final weighted balance and occupancy (3).
